audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Vayne levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 (rated 2/10 each), which contradicts the packet chart (Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Jax, Skill, Vayne), the 52.18% Jax win rate over 1539 games, and this page's own whys — whys[1] says Jax punishes at 2, whys[2] says Jax stuns her out of her kite at 3, whys[4] says Jax kills her at 6.
audit.why: Vayne has no Condemn until level 2 and no burst until items; Jax's Leap Strike into Empower plus Counter Strike out-trades her from level 2 through first item. Only the two-item mark flips, where Silver Bolts' true damage bypasses Grandmaster's Might.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Jax, Skill, Vayne across both layers as one atomic group, with ratings raised on the Jax rows.
sources: kits: vayne E cd 20/18/16/14/12, W trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is written as "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid. That is Jax's title, not the ability name; phases[4].why on the same page already uses Grandmaster's Might.
audit.why: The real ability is Grandmaster's Might (110/100/90s). The page contradicts itself and teaches a fake name.
audit.corrected: All three content occurrences renamed to Grandmaster's Might; spike order otherwise verified — Jax spikes at 2, 6 and Trinity Force, Vayne spikes at Condemn, Final Hour and two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is called 'matchup-defining' with no cooldown attached, and several strings refer to Vayne as 'him'.
audit.why: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 and only 12s at rank 5 — the size of that window is what makes 'engage when it is down' actionable. Silver Bolts needs a third consecutive attack-or-ability on the same target, so Counter Strike's dodge window directly denies the proc, which is the decisive interaction and was only implied.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now names the 20s rank-1 cooldown; pronouns corrected in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.feeding.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json E cd 20/18/16/14/12, W text 'third consecutive attack or ability'
champ-data/_kits/jax.json E text 'dodge all incoming attacks'

audit.why: Win condition (snowball levels 2 through first item, end before her second item) matches the kit maths and is stated clearly in early/mid/late.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Q-leap so she can’t kite. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — bait it, then Q-leap in while she cannot kite.

edits.before: Hold E until Vayne commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Hold Counter Strike through her auto window so Silver Bolts never reaches its third stack, then Q on with W loaded.

edits.before: Hold E until Vayne commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Her autos are dodgeable — eat them with E, stun, and her third Silver Bolt never lands. Then Q on with W.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: If Vayne gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Condemn. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Vayne gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Condemn. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms gives the Armor/MR steroid plus on-hit ramp — you survive her burst and kill her on a Q-leap before she can Condemn you into a wall.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might gives the Armor/MR steroid plus on-hit ramp — you survive her burst and kill her on a Q-leap before she can Condemn you into a wall.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms: pop the Armor/MR steroid and the on-hit ramp on a Q-leap to kill her before she Condemns you off into a wall.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might: pop the Armor/MR steroid and the on-hit ramp on a Q-leap to kill her before she Condemns you off into a wall.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your takeover. When she walks up to farm or poke, Leap Strike onto her, W-Empower the landing hit, and pop Counter Strike to eat her autos and stun her — Silver Bolts can't land its third true-damage proc if she's stunned and dead. At 6, Grandmaster at Arms gives you the Armor/MR steroid to survive her burst and the on-hit ramp to kill her before she Condemns you into a wall. This is your prime all-in; force it on every cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your takeover. When she walks up to farm or poke, Leap Strike onto her, W-Empower the landing hit, and pop Counter Strike to eat her autos and stun her — Silver Bolts needs a third consecutive hit on you and Counter Strike simply erases those attacks. At 6, Grandmaster's Might gives the Armor/MR steroid to survive her burst and the on-hit ramp to kill her before her 20s Condemn is back. This is your prime all-in; force it on every cooldown.

notes: Left untouched and unverified: the repeated claim that Condemn 'cancels your Leap Strike outright'. Vayne's E is a knockback and the kits carry no interrupt/dash-cancel data, so I neither asserted nor removed it. Also unverified: whether Counter Strike's dodge applies to Silver Bolts' true damage itself as opposed to the attacks that carry it — I phrased the rewrite around denying the third consecutive attack, which Riot's own W text supports.
